row.description: 20261004 agi2 open-source-best: the pinned build of the best public ARC-AGI-2 artifact (mikelou1/arc-agi2-lb33-89-minimal-perfpatch, the highest-voted public notebook on the board at 126 votes), re-verified today by screening the attached model sources of every 2026 public ARC-AGI-2 notebook -- all of them attach the same sorokin/qwen3_4b_grids15_sft139 4B checkpoint this build already runs, and the offline-runnable repos (NVARC, transductARC) are the same or weaker family, so there is no stronger open-source AGI-2 solution to lift; predeclared >= 30.97 the pair's first member improves, 30.57-30.96 the second member improves, <= 30.56 no change
